recipes.title: The deliberate approach
recipes.description: A physical camera approach that ends on a clear emotional or product detail.
reference_requirements: One first-frame image; leave a clear straight camera path.

shots.title: Approach
shots.frame: Medium-wide composition at eye level with foreground depth and a clear subject.
shots.action: Hold the initial composition for the opening beat. Move physically forward on a straight level path at an even walking pace; foreground objects separate through parallax. Ease to a stop on a tight medium composition, keeping the subject centered and its size believable. The lens stays fixed; the movement comes from camera travel, with a stable horizon and a final still hold.
shots.audio: Natural location ambience, a restrained rising tone, no dialogue.

recipes.title: Crash zoom to the detail
recipes.description: Snap attention from the whole scene to one unmistakable detail.
reference_requirements: One sharp first frame with the important detail visibly in frame.

shots.title: Crash zoom
shots.frame: A wide view with the point of interest at the optical center.
shots.action: Start wide long enough to read the scene. With the camera body completely stationary, make one rapid optical zoom into the main visible detail. Decelerate cleanly, lock focus on that detail and hold. Keep the perspective and location unchanged: background compression changes from the lens, not forward camera travel. Preserve the original detail without inventing a new reveal.
shots.audio: One short lens whoosh ending in a dry click; quiet room ambience.

recipes.pitfalls: Zoom may obscure the important subject if it is too small or not centered in the reference.

recipes.title: The vertigo reveal
recipes.description: The subject stays the same size while the surrounding depth appears to stretch.

shots.title: Dolly zoom
shots.frame: Centered subject at chest-up or product-medium scale; long visible background.
shots.action: Keep the subject almost exactly the same size in frame. Move the camera steadily backward while optically zooming inward to compensate for that distance change. Let the background compress and its depth relationship change smoothly; keep the subject anchored and sharp. Finish the combined move before the last beat and hold. Keep the horizon level and the subject identity unchanged throughout.
shots.audio: Subtle low tension swell and a short resolving breath; no speech.

recipes.pitfalls: Dolly zoom requires coordinated camera travel and zoom; a prompt alone cannot guarantee exact optics.

shots.action: Suspend the main action at its peak as if time has almost stopped. Trace one smooth 60-degree horizontal camera arc around that moment at constant subject distance and height. Keep airborne objects nearly frozen and maintain the same count and shapes. Preserve the subject pose and lighting direction. End with the subject readable in a three-quarter view and hold; the camera moves while the action stays suspended.

shots.title: Exit pan
shots.frame: Scene A composed with the subject near the center and open space to camera-right.
shots.action: Hold the main subject briefly, then rotate the camera rapidly to the right from a stationary position. Accelerate into horizontal motion blur and end while the whole frame is moving right. Keep the subject and set intact before the pan; create no morph into another location.
shots.audio: A fast rightward swish; carry the location ambience beneath it.

shots.title: Entry pan
shots.frame: Scene B at the destination composition, matching the original horizon and subject scale.
shots.action: Start with a rapid rightward horizontal camera rotation and strong directional motion blur, then decelerate smoothly until the destination subject is centered and sharp. Hold the final readable composition. Keep the destination fixed and make no transformation from another place.
shots.audio: Complete the same swish and settle into Scene B ambience.

recipes.pitfalls: Join the two clips in the editor at matched blur; a single reference image does not define two different locations.

recipes.title: Myth, test, evidence
recipes.description: A testable claim is challenged by visible, honestly described evidence.
reference_requirements: A sourced claim and actual test/result references; no invented demonstration data.

shots.title: The claim
shots.frame: A real object or situation tied to the claim, with the test area visible.
shots.action: Show the subject in a stable medium composition. Make one small setup action that points toward the upcoming test. Keep room for the editor’s exact claim; do not generate written numbers.
shots.audio: Natural setup foley and a brief question cue.

shots.title: The test
shots.frame: An accurate reference of the authorized test procedure.
shots.action: Perform the single procedure shown by the reference at normal speed. Keep the important contact and measurement area inside frame, with the camera fixed. Do not invent a passing result, hidden step or changed product.
shots.audio: Realistic procedure sounds; no celebratory score.

shots.title: The evidence
shots.frame: An actual result or clearly labelled illustrative reference approved by the owner.
shots.action: Hold on the evidence without changing its visible detail. Use a small steady push toward the result, then settle. Leave safe space for the editor’s factual conclusion and source.
shots.audio: Quiet neutral ambience to support the approved conclusion.

recipes.pitfalls: Generated footage is not test evidence. Use real measurements or explicitly label the demonstration conceptual.

recipes.title: Three-step tutorial
recipes.description: A short sequence with one visible action per step and a usable ending.
reference_requirements: One reference frame for each actual step; preserve tools, product and room.

shots.title: Step one
shots.frame: The workspace at the start of the first real step.
shots.action: Carry out only the first small action in the approved process. Keep the important hands and tool contact visible in a stable medium-close composition. End at a clean intermediate state.
shots.audio: Specific tool/contact sounds; add step labels in editing.

shots.title: Step two
shots.frame: The exact intermediate state left by step one.
shots.action: Continue from the reference state and perform only the second action. Keep the same tool, subject and lighting. Use a locked camera and finish on the next intermediate state without skipping a required operation.
shots.audio: Continue the same room tone with specific step-two foley.

shots.title: Step three
shots.frame: The state after step two, ready for the final approved action.
shots.action: Perform the final small action and place the completed result where the camera can read it. Let hands leave the important detail, settle and hold the useful result for the editor-added takeaway.
shots.audio: Final contact sound followed by quiet room tone.

recipes.pitfalls: Review identity, geometry, motion and the final hold before accepting a clip.

recipes.title: Matched before and after
recipes.description: Two honest, matched views joined at a precise edit point.
reference_requirements: Two genuine before/after references with identical camera, lighting and framing.

shots.title: Before
shots.frame: The real before condition, composed to match the after frame.
shots.action: Keep a locked camera and the actual before state unchanged. Allow only small ambient movement. Near the end, move the approved foreground object across the lens until it covers the frame.
shots.audio: Natural ambience and one soft covering swish.

shots.title: After
shots.frame: The genuine after condition at exactly the same camera position, scale and light.
shots.action: Begin with the same foreground cover, then withdraw it to reveal the genuine after state. Keep camera position and lens unchanged and let the final condition remain still long enough to compare.
shots.audio: Continue the swish and settle into the same room tone.

recipes.pitfalls: Do not invent health, beauty, money or product results. The source images must substantiate the comparison.

recipes.title: Travel place, detail, feeling
recipes.description: A place earns attention through one reveal, one local detail and a human-scale ending.
reference_requirements: Three location-consistent frames; verify place facts and imagery rights.

shots.title: Place
shots.frame: A wide composition with a foreground obstruction and the destination partly visible.
shots.action: Track gently sideways past the obstruction to reveal the real destination. Keep architecture, horizon and light consistent, then settle on a clear complete view.
shots.audio: Authentic location ambience; no invented landmark narration.

shots.title: Detail
shots.frame: A close view of a real texture, craft or small activity from that place.
shots.action: Show one small local action or a restrained focus shift onto the actual detail. Keep the camera nearly still and preserve material texture without fabricating people or signage.
shots.audio: Close relevant foley over the continuing ambience.

shots.title: Feeling
shots.frame: A human-scale final view in the same place and time of day.
shots.action: Let the subject pause and take in the location while the camera makes a short slow pullback. Finish with both the person and place readable and a calm final hold.
shots.audio: A restrained musical resolution with authentic ambience.

recipes.pitfalls: Review identity, geometry, motion and the final hold before accepting a clip.

recipes.title: Micro documentary
recipes.description: A specific question, observed process and supported conclusion.
reference_requirements: Rights-cleared subject/process references and a fact-checked script with source links.

shots.title: Question
shots.frame: The documentary subject in its real context, with one meaningful detail visible.
shots.action: Observe a single ordinary action without an exaggerated reaction. Keep the camera at a believable observer’s height with subtle natural drift. End by drawing attention to the detail the narration will question.
shots.audio: Natural field ambience; narration is added from the sourced script.

shots.title: Process
shots.frame: A close reference of the real process or evidence being discussed.
shots.action: Follow one real step with a short lateral camera track. Keep the key contact point visible and preserve the actual object relationships. Do not invent supporting documents, labels or testimony.
shots.audio: Field-recording style process sounds with narration space.

shots.title: Conclusion
shots.frame: A context-consistent final composition of the original subject.
shots.action: Hold on the subject as the visible action reaches a natural stopping point. Let the camera settle and keep an uncluttered ending for the supported conclusion and source credit in editing.
shots.audio: Natural ambience continuing through the final hold.

recipes.pitfalls: Generated reconstruction must be labelled; do not imply it is observed real documentary evidence.

recipes.title: Devotional visual story
recipes.description: A respectful fictional devotional moment with need, help and a quiet resolution.
reference_requirements: Consistent approved character references and one separate frame per beat.

shots.title: A small need
shots.frame: The approved character in a respectful devotional setting with one clear small problem.
shots.action: Start on the small visible need rather than a long establishing view. Let the character look toward the important prop and make one gentle deliberate gesture. Preserve all approved iconography, garments, facial features and location details.
shots.audio: Soft temple or natural ambience; keep any chant or spoken line separately approved.

shots.title: The helping moment
shots.frame: The same character and prop at the moment of gentle help.
shots.action: Carry out one clear helping action with restrained motion. Use a slow short camera push and maintain the same sacred details, expressions and prop count. Keep the cause of the improvement visible; avoid spectacle that overwhelms the story.
shots.audio: A quiet appropriate bell accent and close natural foley.

shots.title: The resolution
shots.frame: The characters at peace in the same setting, with the original prop visible.
shots.action: Let the characters settle into a calm final pose. Hold the original prop and a shared expression in the composition so the payoff connects to the opening. Keep lighting continuous and leave room for an optional editor-added closing line.
shots.audio: A restrained devotional musical resolution with a clean ending.

recipes.pitfalls: Present as an original fictional devotional story, not an event or scripture quotation unless sourced.
